properties.documentation: A bibliographic record representing a particular published edition. It may have one or more known authors, or no identified author when the author is unknown or the publication is anonymous.

An individual physical copy of a Book held by one Library.
Alternative name: BookInstance
A library branch or division that holds book copies and issues library memberships.

documentation.value: Fine for keeping a borrowed book copy past its due date, expressed in USD.
The maximum number of days for which a Book Copy may be borrowed before it must be returned.
The maximum number of active Loans a Borrower may have at this Library at the same time.

properties.documentation:
A record of one BookCopy being borrowed under one LibraryMembership for a period of time. A BookCopy may have at most one open Loan at a time.
An open Loan is a Loan for which returnedAt has no value.
Temporal invariants: - borrowedAt < dueAt - returnedAt >= borrowedAt, when returnedAt exists.
A person registered to use the library system.
The derived availability of a BookCopy. AVAILABLE means it is in circulation and has no open Loan. ON_LOAN means it has an open Loan. UNAVAILABLE means it is not otherwise available.
